roleHelp.admin: Full access, including users and panel settings.
roleHelp.operator: Views the system status and panel settings.
roleHelp.auditor: Views the system status, panel settings and the audit log.

password.title: Set a new password for {username}
password.hint: {username} will be signed out of all sessions.

disable.title: Disable {username}?
disable.content: {username} will be signed out and cannot sign in until the account is enabled again.

resetTotp.title: Reset two-factor authentication for {username}?
resetTotp.content: {username} will be able to sign in with the password alone and can set up two-factor authentication again.

delete.title: Delete {username}?
delete.content: The account is deleted permanently. Its entries in the audit log are kept.
